title: Alpha Flight #69 Marvel Comics 1989 Wrath of Dreamqueen 1st China Force
descriptionText:
Alpha Flight #69 (April 1989, Marvel Comics) -- "Wrath of the Dreamqueen," Part Three of Four. Features the first appearance of China Force. Cover price $1.50 US.

Condition: Very Good. Front cover is clean and glossy; back cover has some light spotting near the top edge (see close-up photo) -- please review all photos as they're of the actual copy you'll receive. I have multiple copies of this issue; condition may vary slightly between copies, but all are in a similar Very Good range.
